    The radical of a corner #

    For Lemma 2.1: "The radical powers of A have the same block description with e_i (rad B₀)^n e_j in each block." For an idempotent e the radical of eAe is e (rad A) e (cornerVal_mem_jacobson, cornerMk_mem_jacobson); when AeA = A the same holds for all radical powers (corner_mem_radPow), by inserting 1 ∈ AeA between the factors.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
